notes.title: SEED OF LIFE - UPDATE V. 1.0.13 AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Leonardo Interactive and Madlight Studio announce that the update v. 1.0.13 of Seed of Life is now available for download. This is the complete changelog:

[b]Overall game:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added inertia to jumps. 
[*]Fixed some physics issues where the player could climb walls when the sprint capsule was activated
[*]Updated cameras to fix some blending issues
[*]Added Walk mode entry in Settings. Cora will walk instead of run by default.
[*]Added tutorial explaining how to recharge the talisman
[*]Added tutorial explaining that the Lumium plants create a regeneration shield when full of Lumium.
[*]Added Lumium plants entry inside the Glossary
[/list]
[b]Area 2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed one obsolete cutscene, now that plants have a tutorial explaining they can heal
[/list]
[b]Area 3:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed some invisible collisions
[*]Improved the climbing part leading to the falling stones challenge
[/list]     
Thanks as always for the support! See you soon for more news!

notes.title: SEED OF LIFE - HERE'S THE OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Publisher[i] Leonardo Interactive[/i] and developer [i]Madlight Studio[/i] have today confirmed that their upcoming futuristic, third-person, sci-fi puzzle platformer[b], Seed of Life will be launching on PC via Steam on August 11th, 2021[/b]. Set in Lumia, a beautiful dystopian semi-open world roamed by strange alien creatures, players will take on the role of Cora as she attempts to find a mysterious device called The Seed and restore life to the dying planet.

[previewyoutube=4Tz5i4RrNqs;full][/previewyoutube]

Seed of Life is an epic adventure game about the persistence of life. You are Cora, the last known survivor of Lumia, a dying world ravaged by alien invaders that are stealing the planet’s lifeforce. Your only hope to save your homeworld is to activate The Seed, an alien device capable of generating the essence of life and save your planet from annihilation. Will you be the light that conquers the darkness?

As you look to the light and navigate your way through a labyrinth-like planet, you’ll come across strange capsules and learn special abilities that allow you to defy the laws of nature and conquer the dangers of a dying world on the brink of destruction. With the help of a cute alien assistant named Nar, you will be able to solve challenging puzzles and topple increasingly menacing invader foes in order to save your world.

[b]Seed of Life Features[/b]

[b]Triple-A Quality Graphics [/b]- Explore a breathtaking sci-fi universe set in a dystopian future. Seed of Life features beautiful graphics and a unique art style where bright colors meet complete darkness.
[b]An Emotional Journey[/b] - Seed of Life is a story-driven game with a dramatic, engaging story full of mysteries to be revealed that will keep you curious and excited to discover more.
[b]Gameplay Focused[/b] - This adventure is packed with RPG elements, puzzles and dangerous creatures. Find Talisman capsules to learn new abilities, collect Lumium to upgrade and strategically use your items to defy gravity and overcome different challenges.
Stealth Combat - Escape from Namurian Shadows roaming the land in search for the remaining Lumium
[b]A World to Discover[/b] - Explore a beautiful and vast labyrinth-like semi-open world where secrets are hidden in every corner and environmental challenges will test your skills. Navigate dangerous paths, clear objectives and find interest points. There’s always something new to uncover!

Seed of Life will be released on PC via Steam on August 11th, 2021 and fans can wishlist the game on Steam now.
